mina: FYI p75 decode on prod jumped ~18% after last night's merge (deploy 3b9f4c2). Seeing memory growth + slower tail on shortseq jobs.
mina: p75 up from 42ms -> 50ms, p95 from 120ms -> 165ms on smallseq (1-16 tokens). Telemetry shows increased KV evictions and batch waits.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: commit 3b9f4c2 -> main @ 2025-11-18T01:09:12Z
lars: linking perf dashboard: https://dash.internal/reports/commit/3b9f4c2
lars: suspect change to batching heuristic in PR #4287 (adaptive_batch_v2)
ben: I ran a flamegraph on a repro; decode time spent in attn_kernel::compute + scheduler lock. Flame: https://logs/fg/175987
ben: snippet: `top functions: attn_kernel::masked_forward 48%, scheduler::pick_batch 22%, kv_cache::evict 12%`
akira: PR 4287 changed pack threshold from 8 -> 12 and added prefetch warmup -> might increase KV churn for shortseq.
mina: can someone run `perf record -g` on a canary pod? I have traces but need symbols from that build.
eva: started a canary run: canary-3b9f4c2-1
eva: logs show `KV_CACHE_EVICT count +4200/min` vs baseline +800/min
lars: that aligns. More evictions -> refill overhead -> attn kernel path triggered more often -> decode p75 increase.
ben: quick bisect idea: revert only batching heuristic patch and run canary.
mina: rollouts: hold canary for now? @deploy-bot hold rollout due perf anomaly
deploy-bot: rollout paused for canary-3b9f4c2-1 (manual hold requested by @mina)
akira: I can prepare a hotpatch revert: revert commit 3b9f4c2 and reapply other commits from that PR excluding batching change.
mina: timeline: if revert fixes canary within 30m we do full revert and new roll with adjusted heuristic.
eva: attaching diff and small repro: ```curl -X POST /generate -d '{"prompt":"short"}' -H 'x-seq:4'``` reproduces locally.
ben: also noticed a scheduler mutex contention metric: `sched_lock_ms` jumped 3x concurrent with evictions.
lars: next steps: akira to push hotpatch revert branch, ben to validate flamegraphs, mina to monitor KV metrics, eva to run 1h canary.
akira: on it, pushing branch `hotfix/revert-batch-threshold` now -> sha 7e1a5f8
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary hotfix 7e1a5f8 -> canary-hotfix-7e1a5f8-1
mina: thanks. If we don't see regressions by +60m we'll revert main. Keep chat updated.
eva: first 10m: KV_EVICT down to +900/min, p75 back to 43ms. Looks promising :thumbsup:
mina: great. flagging for postmortem: need unit perf test for KV churn and scheduler_lock with smallseq workloads.
lars: also should consider KV expiration hysteresis when batch size changes.
ben: adding to perf infra backlog: EVAL-#112: smallseq KV churn test.
mina: assigning owners: perf infra (ben), runtime batching (akira), monitoring alerts (lars).
mina: closing the loop here; will post postmortem once done.
